conservation_reconciliation.control_volume: current plough event stable-DOM/DON/DOP material over Ln=0..Pl(I), redistributed into Ln=1..Pl(I)
source_facts: Addit.for forms SuStdiorma/SuStdiorni/SuStdiorpo by summing current-event stable mass over Ln=0..Pl(I)
Addit.for redistributes each stable pool using Help = He(Ln)/Bo(Pl(I)) divided by the local storage-capacity factor
therefore redistributed mass in layer Ln is He(Ln)/Bo(Pl(I)) times the event accumulator
summing Ln=1..Pl(I) returns exactly the event accumulator because Bo(Pl(I)) is the cumulative He depth
conservation_reconciliation.defect_mechanism: without an event reset, a persistent prior-event accumulator is added to the current-event sum and is redistributed again, introducing stale cross-event mass
conservation_reconciliation.candidate_mechanism: zeroing the event-local accumulators before the current-event summation removes only stale prior-event carryover and leaves the current-event summation and redistribution equations unchanged

expected_to_change_when_nonzero_stable_p: stable DOM/DON/DOP redistributed concentrations and restart state
downstream process and balance outputs causally dependent on those states
